purpose.en: Practise a gentle alternating supine knee-drop movement to lengthen the sides of the waist and lower back.

text.zh: 双膝倒向一侧，肩膀贴地
text.en: Drop both knees to one side, shoulders stay down

text.zh: 仰卧屈髋屈膝，双臂向两侧打开，头颈放松
text.en: Lie on the back with the hips and knees bent, arms open to the sides, and head and neck relaxed.

text.zh: 双膝先向右侧移动，慢慢回中，再换另一侧
text.en: Move both knees to the right first, return slowly through the centre, then change direction.

text.zh: 只转到肩部仍能舒适承托的范围，不用手压膝盖
text.en: Rotate only as far as you can keep the shoulders comfortably supported without pressing on the knees.

commonErrors.zh: 强行把膝盖压地，导致对侧肩膀明显抬起
commonErrors.en: Forcing the knees down until the opposite shoulder lifts.

commonErrors.zh: 用惯性甩腿、扭颈或憋气保持大幅扭转
commonErrors.en: Throwing the legs, twisting the neck or holding the breath in a forced twist.

items.zh: 腰背与髋：小幅缓慢转动，不把更深扭转当作必要目标。
items.en: Lower back and hips: rotate slowly through a modest range without treating a deeper twist as necessary.

items.zh: 肩与颈：头颈自然放松，双肩舒适承托，不强压肩部贴地。
items.en: Shoulders and neck: let the head and neck relax and keep the shoulders comfortably supported rather than forcing them down.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制仰卧或脊柱旋转时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if supine exercise or spinal rotation has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: The source demonstrates knees right then left, one 4-second side movement each, with only 1.2 seconds at each peak. Preserve the legacy 40-second-per-side hold prescription but do not claim this dynamic alternating loop implements a continuous 40-second hold. Editorial/playback reconciliation is pending. Starting side left identifies the initially lengthened body side; knee direction is right. No mirrored media.
definition.movementSides: Both knees first drop right, then left at 4 seconds. Starting side denotes the initially lengthened left body side, not knee travel; source highlight remains both.
editorialNotes: root已核实r3为已发布r2的camera-only修订，有docs/reviews/2026-10-19-visual-audit.md及pr8-previews可见性证据；本轮显式以r3新迁移r4，旧catalog仍r2不改。r2的38度roll修正继续保留，不回退55度。
startingSide=left按膝向右时主要被拉长的体侧记录，movementSides另明确右膝落方向；highlight源仍both，单侧高亮不做假断言。
旧审核明确默认每侧40秒hold，数值及每侧处方保留；现源左右各1.2秒plateau且4秒换向，动态循环不能冒充持续每侧40秒静态hold。播放/处方须编辑裁决，发布继续阻断。
h-knee-hug为不同非旋转下背目标替代候选，不是等价扭转处方；缩小本ID幅度为调整，未核定独立同模式降阶/进阶。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b003.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。
